title: Hyderabad air: AQI hit 509 on Diwali night, reports say moderate by Monday midday
body: Siasat: the citywide AQI touched 509 around 9:30 pm on Nov 8 and Begumpet reached 828. Daily Pioneer reports 'moderate' air after Deepavali; Moneycontrol's midday check ranked Hyderabad cleanest of the metros it listed.

viz.verdict: Hazardous that night; eased by Monday midday
